feature: bounded worker heartbeat supervision and quarantine
source_boundary: model output has no authority; worker transitions are driven only by signed task-service state, lease generation, heartbeat time, and explicit supervisor policy
limitations: This validates the local durable execution engine in QEMU, not cross-host network migration.
Hardware-backed worker identity and provider-specific attestation remain gated.
The quarantine threshold is a bounded policy constant and requires future operational tuning from measured production traces.
